messages:
ellie: Quick sync — we need to finalize the "mini-slice" for Console visibility that goes into next sprint. Focus: dashboards (cost + latency), light tracing hooks, and a first-pass error analytics panel. I want customer-facing acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.

jake: +1. Can we cut scope to 3 dashboards: cost-over-time (by model), latency-percentiles, and error-rate with top routes?

sasha: Agree on the 3 dashboards. For tracing, keep it minimal: add a trace link from a request row that opens the trace viewer, and capture one custom span (model_inference) for p95 timing.

lin: Customer asks to filter cost by team/project tag — do we have tagging in metrics pipeline yet?

jake: Not fully. Proposal: MVP supports route and model filters; project tag can be an opt-in follow-up. Call it "project-tag: deferred" in acceptance criteria.

ellie: Sounds good. I'll write the acceptance snippet. If we hit blockers, we cut the error analytics detail (keep only error-rate and top 5 stack signatures).

ryan: Ops question: do we need tracing sampling changes? Adding model_inference span is cheap but we may need to bump sampling for traces that hit long tail. Ops team can enable dynamic sampling by route if product wants it.

ellie: Keep sampling default but add a flag in config to enable route-based higher sampling for canaries. Ops, please prepare that toggle.

ops-bot: @channel Canary toggle template deployed to staging: /toggles/trace-route-sampling (enabled=false). Use infra token to flip.

ellie: Acceptance criteria (MVP) — paste into ticket: 
```
- Dashboards: 3 views (cost-by-model, latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), error-rate with top routes). Filters: time range, model, route.
- Tracing: UI link from request rows -> opens trace viewer; record `model_inference` span with duration metadata. No global sampling change required.
- Error analytics: show error-rate trend + top-5 stack signatures (no automatic grouping for MVP).
- Performance: dashboards load <2s for 24h window; trace link opens within existing trace viewer latency SLO.
- Rollout: default off for private deployments; hosted customers get feature behind feature-flag; canary config exists for route-based sampling.
```

sasha: Minor ask: add a short UX item to expose why a stack signature is anonymized (privacy). Can be a tooltip.

jake: We'll include the tooltip in the dashboard spec doc.

ellie: OK — owners: dashboards (jake), tracing hooks (sasha), error analytics (lin). PM/QA cross-check: me & ryan. If no major objections, I'll create the sprint tickets now.

lin: No objections. Flagging one risk: infra costs for query-heavy cost dashboard. Suggest caching 1h aggregates as fallback.

jake: Good call — cache 1h rollups and show a "data freshness" badge when using aggregates.

ellie: Perfect. Thanks team. I'll attach the acceptance criteria to the epic and tag customers who requested this. +cc @sre for the canary toggle.

ryan: I'll add the canary runbook and fallback (disable dashboard feature-flag).

ellie: End of thread — will follow up with tickets and owners. :rocket:
